decisions.reason: The financial-obligation sense fits debtor and payment study; it does not imply that bankruptcy has been declared.
The explicit helplessness-in-attack meaning supports general protection vocabulary without claiming a weather-specific synonym for exposure.
The self-contained polluted-state definition fits pollution study; the circular Wiktionary entries and fortification homonym are not selected.
The transitive sadness meaning is clear and appropriate beside depress; no unsupported claim about duration or intensity is approved.
The vivid verbal-description meaning supports portrayal and profile study without asserting that graphical precision is always required.
Available rescue, religious and delivery senses are distinct; the sole business saver anchor confuses rescue with financial saving, leaving intended scope unresolved.
The noun merely repeats the headword as a muscle name and the adjective concerns shape; neither provides a sufficiently clear English fitness meaning here.
The verified signal-processing device is a specialist electronic sense, not supported by the business receiver anchor's intended learning topic.
A formal objection is a complete meaning appropriate to argument and official business; hesitation and politeness are not entailed.
The state-to-private ownership or control definition directly supports the privatization learning context.
Putting something under private control or ownership matches the business privatize anchor; the nationhood-removal homonym is excluded.
The plural-only clothing meaning is explicit and relevant to jeans; retain plural restrictions and reject the unsupported formal-register comparison.
The primary-meaning sense is appropriate for academic language study; it is not a replacement for every use of semantic.
Narrative resolution is verified, but the only fitness omega anchor does not establish a relevant learning topic for this literary specialist.
Increasing density is verified but the proposed fitness compression connection substitutes a materials-science process for an exercise context.
No exact evidence supports this joined spelling; an independently sourced dental surgeon identity mapping is required before release.
The explicit number and arrangement of teeth meaning is useful in academic anatomy, not an interchangeable term for an individual tooth.
The adjective meaning leaving fits outgoing personnel; no unsupported implication of ceremony or finality is retained.
A trusted recipient of goods or deposits is a clear business meaning; the broad corporate-stakeholder equivalence is not approved.
The moral-corruption verb supports business ethics discussion, not technical data corruption or an arbitrary substitute for every use of corrupt.
Appointing someone as deputy is explicit and appropriate to workplace delegation; the Scottish noun is a separate unselected sense.
The crane with lifting tackle on a boom is relevant to workplace equipment and avoids treating every tall crane as a derrick.
Exact unaccented-headword evidence identifies the seated body part, relevant to posterior anatomy; no unsupported register guidance is published.
The malformed spelling has no exact source evidence and resembles another existing record; guessing an accent correction risks duplicate identity.
Eliminating segregation is an explicit social-science meaning; it does not equate to every broader use of integration.
The drying-agent definition is appropriate for academic chemistry; the old herbicide comparison is not generally true and remains unpublished.
Drying meanings are verified, but the sole business shrink anchor does not establish the scientific or preservation context this proposed connection needs.
The dryness-from-water-removal meaning can support environmental drought reading; exclude the fitness dehydration substitution and any medical inference.
Loss of hope or confidence is clearly defined; the old comparison with depression's severity or duration is not clinically supported or retained.
The joined phrase has no exact factual entry or reviewed identity mapping; do not infer a clinical facility definition from the old model gloss.
The evidence concerns a digestion-aiding drug; the fitness digestive anchor alone does not justify adding this pharmacological specialist.
The intended measurement meaning is plausible but no exact extracted source sense is available for this plural record; a sourced morphology mapping is still needed.
The joined spelling lacks exact dictionary evidence; preserve the record until a verified spaced-phrase identity can be attached.
The two-atoms-per-molecule oxygen allotrope is an explicit academic chemistry meaning; it is not interchangeable with dioxide or fitness oxygen advice.
The explicit separated opposite-charge or magnetic-pole meaning supports academic polar terminology without relying on a circular dipole definition.
The administration or directorate sense supports organizational vocabulary; the separate creative-director sense and general superiority claims are not inferred.
Loss of loyalty or sympathy is explicit and relevant to workplace relations; it is narrower than merely failing to satisfy.
The refusal or withdrawal of allowance meaning fits administrative decisions without assuming a particular constitutional veto power.
Money paid out or spent is a self-contained financial meaning; no tax-deductibility or mandatory specific-fund restriction is added.
The separate independent-unit sense fits apart and distinguishes this spelling from discreetly without adding unsourced examples.
